responsibility: Defines MIR-level constant representations, including evaluated constant values, indirect allocation-backed constants, and unevaluated constants, and provides the core conversions, determinism checks, formatting, and caller-location construction used to move between interpreter allocations, scalar values, and typed MIR constants.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `ty/consts.rs`, which defines interned type-level constants (`ty::Const`) and valtree-based forms in the type system, this file defines MIR constants as they appear in lowered MIR and interpretation, including `ConstValue`, allocation-backed constants, and MIR-specific unevaluated constants.
